privacy.title: Your
privacy.sub: What Nudgy sends, where it goes, and how to take it back. Your server: {{host}}.
privacy.askBody: Only while you hold the hotkey: a screenshot of the screen your cursor is on, the names of buttons in the app in front, and your question. It goes to {{host}}, which passes it to the AI provider that server is set up with, then throws it away. Screenshots and recordings are never saved or logged.
privacy.lessonBody: The same, each time you pause so Nudgy can check the step. Between checks, nothing is sent.
privacy.walkBody: Stay on this computer until you share one. Shared copies leave screenshots out unless you include them. Password fields are recorded as [hidden].
privacy.neverBody: Password fields and the apps in your list are never captured, even if you press the hotkey. Nudgy doesn't watch your screen in the background. A small "looking" tag shows every time it does look.
privacy.exportHelp: Your lessons, skills, questions, walkthroughs and settings, plus your account if you're signed in. One JSON file.
privacy.deleteLocalHelp: Lessons, skills, reviews, question history and walkthroughs on this computer.
privacy.deleteAccountHelp: Also deletes your account, usage and shared links on the server, and cancels any subscription.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Hold the hotkey anywhere, ask how to do something, and Nudgy tells you the next step and moves its cursor to the exact button. Ask it to teach you, and it walks you through step by step, in your own app.
onboarding.welcomePrivacy: It only looks at your screen while you hold the keys or during a lesson you started.
onboarding.permsTitle: Three things macOS will ask about
onboarding.permsBody: Nudgy needs these to see the screen you ask about, find buttons by name, and hear your question. You can change them later in System Settings → Privacy & Security.

perm.screenWhy: To see what you see, only when you ask
perm.accessibilityWhy: To find buttons by name and skip password fields
perm.microphoneWhy: To hear your question while you hold the keys

onboarding.permsRestart: After allowing screen recording, macOS may ask you to reopen Nudgy.
